proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5523.3 *dag gives Lahnda dagg, Punjabi dagaṛ and Hindi dagṛā road. The dental-initial survey forms select this branch rather than retroflex *ḍag; regional transmission remains open. Exact survey form daɡaɾ is preserved.

assignments.Notes: CDIAL 5523.3 *dag gives Lahnda dagg, Punjabi dagaṛ and Hindi dagṛā road. The dental-initial survey forms select this branch rather than retroflex *ḍag; regional transmission remains open. Exact survey form daɡaɾ is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10840 rodati gives Prakrit roaï/royaï and Hindi ronā, Gujarati rovũ weep. The survey ro cry stem selects the o-vowel branch, not section 2 rudati. Exact survey form ro is preserved.
